description: Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka - Notifying the public that of the Closure of Runway at Bandaranaike International Airport for the purpose of resurfacing from 06.01.2017 to 06.04.2017
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the temporary closure of Bandaranaike International Airport's runway for resurfacing work. The content pertains to airport operations and public service announcements about flight schedules, which does not fit any of the government-related classifications (Types 1-3) as it involves no government structural changes, personnel appointments, or portfolio assignments. It also does not fit any of the specialized categories (Types 4-9) as it is not about land, legal/regulatory matters, commercial issues, elections, public service administration, or judicial/law enforcement. Therefore, it falls under Miscellaneous (Type 10) for general administrative announcements not covered by other categories.
